§23.12 Asymptotic Approximations

ⓘ
Keywords:
Weierstrass elliptic functions, asymptotic approximations
Notes:
These approximations follow from the expansions given in §23.8(ii). For (23.12.4) use Lawden (1989, (6.2.7)) and (20.4.8).
Permalink:
http://dlmf.nist.gov/23.12
See also:
Annotations for Ch.23

If q(=eπ⁢i⁢ω3/ω1)→0 with ω1 and z fixed, then

23.12.1 ℘⁡(z)=π24⁢ω12⁢(−13+csc2⁡(π⁢z2⁢ω1)+8⁢(1−cos⁡(π⁢zω1))⁢q2+O⁡(q4)),
ⓘ
Symbols:
O⁡(x): order not exceeding, ℘⁡(z) (= ℘⁡(z|𝕃) = ℘⁡(z;g2⁡,g3⁡)): Weierstrass ℘-function, π: the ratio of the circumference of a circle to its diameter, csc⁡z: cosecant function, cos⁡z: cosine function, 𝕃: lattice, q: nome, z: complex and ω1, ω3, ω2=−ω1−ω3: lattice generators
